baseline.before:
(-ordered-page [s lo after hi limit direction max-bytes]
    (let [table (:table s) descending? (= direction :desc)
          ;; Keep the native operation inside the actual SDK callback. A raw
          ;; ETS function value is correctly refused by Source invocation.
          step (fn [key] (if descending? (ets/prev table key) (ets/next table key)))
          bound (if descending? hi lo)
          start (if after (step after)
                  (if (seq (ets/lookup table bound)) bound (step bound)))
          inside? (fn [k] (and (not (end-of-table? k)) (<= lo k hi)))]
      (loop [k start out [] last nil bytes 0]
        (if (or (= limit (count out)) (not (inside? k)))
          {:datoms out :last last :bytes bytes :end? (not (inside? k))}
          (let [entry (first (ets/lookup table k)) weight (cache/footprint entry)]
            (cond
              (nil? weight) {:refused :opaque-value :datoms [] :last last :bytes bytes}
              (> (+ bytes weight) max-bytes)
                {:datoms out :last last :bytes bytes :end? false :byte-limited? true}
              :else (recur (step k) (conj out (erlang/element 2 entry)) k (+ bytes weight))))))))
